verdict.rationale: LocalAI clearly runs headlessly. It ships as a single binary or Docker container that serves an OpenAI-compatible API, can be launched from the CLI with a model, and accepts a `--preload-models` flag or env var to set up models without the web UI, so it suits scripted automation. CI use specifically is only implied: the 'tested in CI' claim refers to the vendor's own CI, not a documented pattern for running LocalAI inside a user's pipeline. missing for 10: documented CI-pipeline usage (e.g. GitHub Actions/service-container recipe), a non-interactive or approval-free mode for the `local-ai chat` agent, an OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent/hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
